_comment: FX-AUTO-01: archive_old_issues + close_old_issues + beat registration. Transcribed from bgtasks/issue_automation_task.py:23-150; beat entry pi_dash/celery.py:42-45; groups from utils/constants.py:76-88.

archive.date: archive_at = timezone.now().date() (DATE, not datetime); per-issue payload embeds str(archive_at)
archive.guard: if issues: (queryset truthiness — evaluates a query); inner if issues_to_update:
archive.projects: Project.objects.filter(archive_in__gt=0) — strictly greater; archive_in None excluded by the comparison
archive.queryset: Issue.issue_objects.filter(Q(project, archived_at__isnull=True, updated_at__lte=now - days(archive_in*30), state__group__in=CLOSED), Q(issue_cycle__isnull=True) | (cycle ended AND not null), Q(issue_module__isnull=True) | (module target passed AND not null)).filter(intake status 1 | -1 | 2 | null)

beat.name: check-every-day-to-archive-and-close
beat.note: The SCHEDULE row itself is owned by D-10/F-09 transcription; this domain registers the same Celery task name string only.

close.close_state: project.default_state (select_related prefetch) UNLESS None -> State.objects.filter(group='cancelled').first() (may itself be None -> issue.state=None; port as-is)

delay_per_issue.requested_data: json.dumps({'closed_to': str(issue.state_id)}) — str() of the FK AFTER assignment

close.mutate: issue.state = close_state (model instance assigned, not id)
close.queryset: same shape as archive with close_in and OPEN groups

entrypoint: archive_and_close_old_issues() calls archive_old_issues() then close_old_issues() SEQUENTIALLY in one worker run; both wrapped: any exception -> log_exception + return
intake_status_rule: Q(issue_intake__status=1) | Q(status=-1) | Q(status=2) | Q(issue_intake__isnull=True) — statuses 0/-2 and any other int are EXCLUDED from both runs
month_quirk_port_as_is: month = timedelta(days=n*30) (issue_automation_task.py:43,104): a 1-month setting means 30 days, 12 months means 360 days — do NOT convert to calendar months
queryset_sql_shape: SELECT ... FROM issues WHERE project_id = %s AND archived_at IS NULL AND updated_at <= %s AND state_id IN (SELECT id FROM states WHERE `group` IN (...)) AND (issue_cycle IS NULL OR (cycle.end_date < %s AND issue_cycle IS NOT NULL)) AND (issue_module IS NULL OR (module.target_date < %s AND issue_module IS NOT NULL)) AND (intake.status IN (1,-1,2) OR intake IS NULL) — now evaluated THREE times per run (updated_at bound, cycle end_date bound, module target_date bound all read timezone.now() independently)
